site rate a night, before tax

Every RV rate asks for at least 2 nights from Saturday, October 17, 2026 and Tuesday, October 20, 2026 and Tuesday, January 26, 2027 and Saturday, January 30, 2027 and Tuesday, June 8, 2027 and Saturday, June 12, 2027.
Both RV rates need at least 2 nights on every date read.

fees.note: From the park's RoverPass listing (read 2026-10-14): C$60 a night and C$360 a week for its one RV rate, a partial-hookup site with the dump station, for one family of 2 adults and their children, with fees for up to 2 more people. RoverPass sold no date: the park is closed from October 16 to May 14 and books 6 months ahead.
